startup.scope: Actual built Node CLI process launch, loopback URL, authenticated HTTP first ledger, then static rules; no prior core; new product directory. One observation, auto-prices disabled; OS cache uncontrolled.

nativeResource.scope: Separate direct core+Web harness run on the same corpus shape with new product data; excludes Node/browser. Includes core initialization, ledger collection/query, configuration collection and static rules.
nativeResource.note: Harness Node peak includes fixture construction and measurement orchestration; not a product-only Node result. Peaks are separate runs, not summed concurrent memory.

exactBlocks.scope: Release library test including fixture creation, inventory/token estimate and exact analysis; parsing time alone is not full startup.

browser.scope: Prestarted loopback host, synthetic 23-turn fixture + archived task metadata, prior index empty, browser/OS cache not controlled; page navigation only, excludes CLI startup and browser RAM. Four-second preference delay is controlled.

limitations: No universal ETA or speedup claim
No real disk exhaustion; SQLite quota test only
Other platforms and Hook/injection/execution adapters unverified
Static analysis reparses each collection; no persistent body/block cache
